id./param/scenario/cs/b_020_cs_140.pack|cs_: "Come, Jasper!
"Hyaah!
"Haaah!
"Tch. Still the same brute strength, Hendrik.
"Ha ha ha! You two are so lively!
"You have not yet greeted her. My daughter, Jade.
"You two will protect the future of this kingdom. I count on you, Hendrik, Jasper.
"Jasper, your wits and my strength will make us the kingdom's finest knights, protecting the Princess!
"Hey! Are you listening, Jasper!
"Wh-What!?
"They say the Shield of Heliodor, given to the kingdom's greatest knight, is in the King's private chamber.
"I read it in this book... The Shield of Heliodor, awarded to the strongest knight, is in the King's chamber.
"Don't you want to see it? It will be our shield one day, won't it?
"But how? You can't get into the King's chamber without magic.
"Tell no one. The other day I caught a sneak thief. Guess who?
"The King himself. He came out from behind the cupboard and took a bite of cake. That must lead to his chamber.
"Ha ha ha! I see! He's been scolded by the Queen for his belly!
"Meet in the kitchen tonight. Agreed?
"Yes!
"...Yes, I had long forgotten. There's a passage from the kitchen to the King's chamber. But what was that vision?
"...Crossing time to know the world's memories. So that is the Luminary's power tied to the Tree...
"The kitchen is behind the dining hall in the north of the castle. Let's check the cupboard. Let's go, {var:1}."
